notes.title: Action-Card Set Release & Bug Fixes
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone![/p][olist][*][p]Numerous tweaks and fixes have been applied to the current version of the game. Most were minor bugs that didn’t prevent players from reaching every ending but could slightly spoil the experience. Thank you to everyone who reported them.[/p][/*][*][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3884140/Legends_of_Savvarah_Children_of_the_Sun__Action_Cards/"]Action cards.[/url][/p][p]Many players said they enjoyed the illustration cards created for the action scenes. Because of this, we’ve decided to release them in a large format and high quality as a separate add-on.[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44444543/c1c90ab62d4e356d8ec7cf1843b4c32ee566c482.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44444543/7fa40eed0bf703cf0f8e208a084f7441c37ade2c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]You can consider this set one way to support the developer.[/p][p]You can also follow all updates—new games, books set in the Savvarah universe, updates to older projects, and so on by subscribing to updates directly on [url="https://store.steampowered.com/developer/SINOVAR"]Steam[/url].[/p][p]Thanks for your attention : )[/p]

notes.title: About the upcoming release
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

If you enjoyed [b]Children of the Sun[/b], it would be great if you left a review—this helps promotion a lot.

No DLC releases are planned. [b]Children of the Sun[/b] is a fully finished story that I’m not intending to expand.

At the beginning of July: «[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2413920/Legends_of_Savvarah_Flowers_and_Scorpions/?curator_clanid=45559644]Legends of Savvarah: Flowers and Scorpions[/url][/b]» is scheduled for release.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44444543/c0b5f82196e76efe9e32d5fb2c85b72eeb345e00.jpg[/img]

You’ll return to the world of Savvarah, but the location, characters, and plot are completely different.

Our main heroine is a militant member of the cult of the god Dadar, sent as a spy to foreign lands.

This is a short game—more compact and local than Children of the Sun. It will feature 11 endings and three main characters with whom relationships beyond friendship are possible, though the game itself is not romance-focused.
